## Where presets fit

Entrance presets work with `moveEnter`, `moveLeave`, `[move]`, `moveInView` and staggered children. The two interaction presets, `lift` and `press`, are for `moveWhileHover` and `moveWhileTap`. They are the fastest way to add consistent motion to empty states, cards, menus, alerts, SVG icons and list reveals.

- **Use for simple moments.** Choose a preset when the element only needs an entrance, exit or reveal.
- **Keep timing local.** Tune `moveDuration`, `moveDelay`, `moveEasing` or `moveSpring` without changing the preset.
- **Graduate when state matters.** Move to variants, presence, drag, scroll or layout when behaviour gets richer.

## Gallery

Every preset below is the real directive, rendered live. Replay any preview to watch it again; reduced motion shows the end state.

::demo[presets-gallery]

## Product UI reveals

Use these for cards, panels, empty states, menus and list items.

```html title="fade-up.html"
<article moveEnter="fade-up">Billing summary</article>
```

```html title="slide-up.html"
<aside moveEnter="slide-up" moveLeave="slide-down">Filters</aside>
```

```html title="zoom-in.html"
<span moveEnter="zoom-in" moveDuration="300ms">Saved</span>
```

## Interaction

`lift` is a 4px rise for cards, buttons and links — mouse and pen only, because touch has no hover. `press` is a 3% scale-down while pressed, the touch feedback for anything tappable. They write different style channels, so they compose on one element.

```html title="lift-press.html"
<a moveWhileHover="lift" moveWhileTap="press">Pricing</a>
```

## Feedback and attention

Use these sparingly, for validation, loading and meaningful emphasis.

```html title="pulse.html"
<div moveEnter="pulse" moveDuration="900ms">Syncing</div>
```

```html title="shake.html"
<input moveEnter="shake" aria-invalid="true" />
```

```html title="tada.html"
<strong moveEnter="tada">Workspace ready</strong>
```

## SVG icons

Use these for checkmarks, route lines, progress strokes and product icons. `icon-draw` reveals the actual SVG stroke instead of faking it with opacity.

```html title="icon-draw.html"
<path moveEnter="icon-draw" d="M14 25.5 21 32l14-17" stroke="currentColor" />
```

```html title="icon-pulse.html"
<svg moveEnter="icon-pulse"><path d="..." /></svg>
```

## When to avoid a preset

If the element has named states, use `moveVariants`. If Angular should keep a removed view alive while it exits, wrap it in `movePresence`. If the pointer, layout or scroll position drives the behaviour, use `moveDrag`, `moveLayout`, `moveScroll` or `moveParallax`. The complete preset type is [`MovePreset`](/docs/reference/move-preset).
